UFC 320: Live Stream Ankalaev vs Pereira, Dvalishvili vs Sandhagen

Watch one of the most anticipated UFC events of the year - UFC 320 from Abu Dhabi, UAE. The main event features a light heavyweight title fight: champion Alex 'Poatan' Pereira vs Russian contender Magomed Ankalaev. The co-main event is a bantamweight contender bout between Merab 'The Machine' Dvalishvili and Cory 'Sandman' Sandhagen.

Date and Start Time: October 05, 2025, main card approx. 22:00 UTC (Oct 04).

Main Event: Magomed Ankalaev vs Alex Pereira (Light Heavyweight Title)

Fighter Analysis

Magomed Ankalaev enters on an unbeaten streak. The Russian is an all-round fighter with striking and grappling skills, controlling distance and delivering powerful blows. His wrestling is a key advantage against Pereira.

Alex Pereira is a kickboxing legend and feared knockout artist. His plan: keep the fight standing and seek a knockout. Weakness: takedown defense, making the fight intriguing.

Prediction

Striker vs grappler. Experts favor Ankalaev for his versatility. If he takes the fight to the mat, chances increase; Pereira is dangerous on the feet.

  • Likely Outcome: Ankalaev win by decision or late-round TKO.
  • Key Factor: Can Pereira defend Ankalaev's takedowns?

Co-Main Event: Merab Dvalishvili vs Cory Sandhagen (Bantamweight Contender Bout)

Fighter Analysis

Merab Dvalishvili ('The Machine') is the top title contender. Known for endurance, dominant wrestling, and ground control. On a 10-fight winning streak, aiming for a title shot.

Cory Sandhagen is a creative striker, using stance switches and unexpected angles. His goal: keep the fight standing and avoid takedowns.

Prediction

Competitive matchup: Dvalishvili's pressure and wrestling vs Sandhagen's footwork and striking. Bookmakers slightly favor Merab.

  • Likely Outcome: Dvalishvili win by unanimous decision.
  • Key Factor: Can Sandhagen stop takedowns and maintain distance?

Watch UFC 320 live on tutsport.net for these exciting fights!
